en.headline: Youdi Robotics jumps more than 140 percent on Hong Kong debut
en.dek: The Wuxi-based commercial service-robot maker opened at HK$35 against an issue price of HK$14.45 after its public offer was about 140 times subscribed.
body: Shares of Youdi Robotics (優地機械人, 03231) began trading on the Main Board of the Hong Kong stock exchange on Wednesday morning and opened at HK$35, about 142 percent above the final offer price of HK$14.45.

The company, based in Wuxi, issued 45 million H shares. After reallocation, about 2.78 million shares went to the Hong Kong public offer, which received 27,933 valid applications and was subscribed about 140 times. The international placing was about 0.99 times covered. Gross proceeds were about HK$650 million, or about HK$577 million net of expenses.

The group develops indoor and outdoor delivery and cleaning robots and industry AI vision models. SenseTime affiliate SensePower Management and a 58.com unit were named as cornerstone investors for a combined US$3 million. The company said most of the proceeds would go to research and development, with further sums earmarked for expansion and acquisitions.

The listing documents cautioned that ownership remains concentrated and that the share price could swing sharply on thin trading. Separate market data later in the morning showed the stock changing hands well above the opening print.

zh.headline: 優地機械人港股上市高開逾1.4倍
zh.dek: 無錫商用服務機械人公司優地機械人（03231）周三掛牌，開市報35港元，較招股價14.45港元升約142%，公開發售超購約140倍。
body: 優地機械人（無錫）股份有限公司H股周三早上在港交所主板開始買賣，開市報35港元，較最終發售價14.45港元高出約142%。
公司全球發售4,500萬股H股，經重新分配後香港公開發售約278萬股，接獲27,933份有效申請，認購約140倍；國際配售認購約0.99倍。所得款項總額約6.50億港元，扣除開支後淨額約5.77億港元。
公司主營室內外配送及清潔機械人，以及行業應用人工智能視覺模型。商湯旗下SensePower Management及58集團一間附屬公司出任基石投資者，合共認購300萬美元。公司表示所得款項主要用作研發，其餘用於業務擴展及收購。
上市文件提醒股權集中於少數股東，即使少量成交亦可能令股價大幅波動。上午稍後市場報價顯示，股價仍高於開市水平。
